_comment: The local model endpoint for the reconstruction loop (docs/llm-harness-design.md -> The harness). URL: set an explicit full 'endpoint' for providers that do not use the /v1 convention; otherwise 'base_url' is used and '/v1/chat/completions' is appended. 'proxy': 'none' (direct, default), 'env' (honor http_proxy/https_proxy), or an explicit http(s):// URL. No secret is stored here: an API key, if the endpoint needs one, is read from the environment variable named by 'api_key_env' (optional — a local llama.cpp server needs none). 'temperature' and 'seed' are sent only when set (non-null), so leaving them null lets the server/preset decide; set them here or per run with --temperature/--seed. See tools/loop/model.py.
